about_short_description.short_description: Sweep is a software company developing software for businesses to reduce their carbon emissions.

product.name: Sweep Platform
product.description: A cloud-based sustainability data management platform for collecting, consolidating, validating, analyzing, and reporting ESG and carbon data across an organization and its value chain.

product.name: Carbon Management
product.description: Software for measuring, calculating, and managing Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas emissions, including corporate and product carbon footprints, with auditable data and emissions reduction tracking.

product.name: Supplier Emissions
product.description: A supplier engagement and data collection solution for obtaining primary Scope 3 emissions data, assessing supply-chain risks, and coordinating reduction activities across the value chain.

product.name: Sustainability Reporting
product.description: ESG reporting software that reuses centralized sustainability data to prepare traceable, audit-ready disclosures across regulatory and voluntary reporting frameworks.

product.name: Decarbonization Strategy
product.description: Software for setting emissions targets, modeling reduction pathways, planning initiatives, and tracking carbon and financial progress toward net-zero objectives.

product.name: Financed Emissions Management
product.description: A solution for financial institutions to collect, map, analyze, and report carbon and sustainability data across investment portfolios, loans, and other financed activities.
